usedFor: Vercel holds your deployments, and Bolna phones someone through “Make a Phone Call” when a “Deployment Failed” event arrives.

bestTemplate.name: “Deployment Failed” in Vercel, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: A failed deployment triggers a call placed through your Bolna account, so someone hears about it fast.

watchOut: “Deployment Canceled” is a separate trigger, so a canceled deployment will not ring this call.
